detail.longDescription: Anthropic's new Siren test plants a credential just outside a weak sandbox and asks: will the AI agent go get it? Recent Claude models reached outside in 21-32% of scenarios, but misused the bait only 0.6-1.6%. The cheapest fix was a short system prompt spelling out the sandbox rules. My take on agent sandbox escape: https:// blog.manig.dev/blog/agent-sand box-escape-siren # AIAgents # AISecurity
